title: Turn technical documentation into actions
summary: Read an English runbook and extract executable steps without translation.
learningObjectives: Identify prerequisites, commands, success signals and recovery steps directly in English.

sections.title: Your mission
sections.body: A teammate asks you to perform a safe cache migration using only the English runbook.

sections.title: Cache migration runbook
sections.content: Before starting, confirm that the queue depth is below 100 and create a configuration snapshot. Enable read-only mode, then run cachectl migrate --target v2. A successful migration prints MIGRATION_COMPLETE and the new cache reports healthy within two minutes. If health remains degraded, run cachectl rollback --snapshot latest, disable read-only mode and notify the on-call engineer. Do not retry migration until the incident owner approves it.

exercises.question: What must happen before the migration command?
options: Confirm queue depth and create a snapshot.
Notify the incident owner after retrying.
correctAnswer: Confirm queue depth and create a snapshot.
exercises.explanation: Both conditions appear before the migration steps.

performanceTask.title: Produce an execution checklist
performanceTask.scenario: You must hand a safe four-step checklist to the engineer running the migration.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Read once and write the actions from memory without translating the runbook.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Write four English bullets covering prerequisite, command, success signal and rollback/escalation.
performanceTask.modelResponse: • Confirm queue depth is below 100 and save a configuration snapshot. • Enable read-only mode and run cachectl migrate --target v2. • Verify MIGRATION_COMPLETE and healthy status within two minutes. • If degraded, rollback the latest snapshot, disable read-only mode and notify on-call; do not retry without approval.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Return to the source, correct one omitted safety condition, then rewrite without copying full sentences.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: A second runbook says to back up the schema, run dbctl upgrade, verify SCHEMA_OK, and restore the backup if validation fails. Produce the same four-part checklist.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Read a new short runbook and extract prerequisite, action, success signal and recovery without translation.

rubric.label: Correct sequence
rubric.description: Keeps prerequisite, action, verification and recovery in order.

rubric.label: Safety conditions
rubric.description: Includes snapshot, rollback and approval constraints.

rubric.label: English processing
rubric.description: Paraphrases actions without a Vietnamese translation step.
